description: Available with Bootify Professional. Return the saved repository URL, target branch and defaultCommitMessage derived from current changes using the builder's commit message generator. This does not contact the remote or preview a Git diff. Credentials are never returned. If unconfigured, open configurationUrl to configure Git in the builder. Successful calls record MCP usage and activity for this project.
